what_happened: Published draft rules for online forex and CFD trading. The draft covers brokers and platforms, not prop firms. Not in force yet.
The CySEC chairman said retail prop trading is not an ESMA priority at this time.
Kraken, a crypto exchange, launched Kraken Prop, the first evaluation programme run by an exchange, after buying Breakout.
FTMO changed its terms to describe payouts as a reward for the data a trader generates, with no funded account language. OANDA Prop Trader was folded into FTMO in March 2026.
The RBI Alert List of forex firms with no permission to serve Indian residents grew to 95 names. It includes the prop firms FTMO, entry 13, and FundedNext, entry 83.
MyFundedFutures hired ComplianceAlpha to run its compliance after it stopped serving 21 countries in 2024.
A court threw out the CFTC 2023 case against Traders Global Group, the company behind My Forex Funds. The case cannot be refiled, and the court ordered sanctions against the CFTC.

what_happened: The SPK blocked access to 58 crypto and prop firm websites, among them BrightFunded, BEM Funding and Lion Funded. List 2024-56.
The CNB said a platform that sells access to demo accounts does not need a licence while the trading stays simulated.
Press release titled Beware of online trading video games, a warning to consumers about prop firm challenges.
The CNB said some prop firm models may fall under MiFID, the EU law on investment services.
Regulators ran first reviews of prop trading. The CySEC chair said prop trading will fall under robust regulation at some point.
Warning against a shadow investment game. The FSMA said prop firms hold no licence and may not offer investment services.
